title: Important text and emphasis
goal: Marks equipment operating instructions with an important warning and a word that needs to be emphasized.
summary: strong indicates the importance of the content, and em indicates the emphasis when reading aloud. Changing the stress position sometimes changes the emphasis of the sentence.
tasks: Mark "cut off the power" in the first paragraph with strong .
Mark "front" in the second paragraph with em to emphasize the direction of opening the cover.
hint: Check the range of tags. Place the target word between the opening and closing tags, leaving the period outside the tags.

example.note: Restaurant menus mark safety-related allergy information as important. Booking reminders reread "Friday" to highlight the deadline.
